description: This file defines the 'dm_bss_list_t' class, which extends 'dm_bss_t' and 'db_easy_mesh_t', providing methods for managing lists of BSS (Basic Service Set) structures, including initialization, database synchronization, configuration, and iteration over BSS entries.

classes.name: dm_bss_list_t
classes.description: Class managing a list of BSS structures and providing database and configuration operations, extending 'dm_bss_t' and 'db_easy_mesh_t'.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the system or component, setting up necessary configurations.

methods.name: get_dm_orch_type
methods.description: Determines the DM orchestration type based on the database client and BSS information.

methods.name: update_list
methods.description: Updates the list with the given BSS information and operation type.

methods.name: delete_list
methods.description: Deletes the list and frees resources.

methods.name: init_columns
methods.description: Sets up columns for BSS list display or processing.

methods.name: sync_db
methods.description: Synchronizes the database with the current state.

methods.name: update_db
methods.description: Performs database operations based on the specified operation type.

methods.name: search_db
methods.description: Searches the database for an entry using the provided key.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets configuration in the database client based on JSON data.

methods.name: get_first_bss
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the first BSS entry (pure virtual).

methods.name: get_next_bss
methods.description: Returns the next BSS entry in the list (pure virtual).

methods.name: get_bss
methods.description: Returns a BSS entry associated with a key (pure virtual).

methods.name: remove_bss
methods.description: Removes a BSS entry identified by the key (pure virtual).

methods.name: put_bss
methods.description: Inserts a BSS entry using the provided key (pure virtual).
